question: On the same locally-hosted synthetic single-resource flat-JSON substrate (/resource/{id} stdlib http.server, deterministic _matches verification, honest per-trajectory-reset constant sum-counter resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser_steps=4 without jitter/n*3200/f*6.0/bijective proxy, trajectory-grouped max |rho_shuffled|<0.20), does the validated freshness guard (Jaccard 0.85 required-filtered {id,name,email} + response-derived endpoint _template/X-Csrf-Token + ETag+max-age=0, recalibrated confidence 0.95 fresh/0.85 stale) sustain TN>=0.85 (Wilson lower>0.75), FA<=0.10 calibrated (global ECE<=0.15 and per-class ECE_fresh<=0.15 ECE_stale<=0.15), UNKNOWN prevalence-aware [0.00,0.18] and within stale_rate+/-0.07 at realistic 15% stale prevalence (180 fresh + 30 stale + 150 noise = 360 requests, 12 fresh trajectories of 15 + 6 stale families of 5 fresh+5 stale in the 30-stale pool) with non-degenerate Wilson and 5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap CIs and NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY fresh-only optional-field churn FA<=0.10 vs B-NO-GUARD delta>=0.15, and when health-gated transferred to a distributed shared-WAL Flask/JWT + nginx If-None-Match/304 substrate at n>=800 non-304 (single-node Flask health-gated first, then distributed 2x gunicorn+nginx round-robin with HS256 shared TESTBED_SECRET and X-Worker-Pid>=2) does it sustain the same TN/FA/ECE gates per endpoint and overall, thereby testing the step from bounded synthetic EXPERIMENTAL (42.8% stale degenerate CIs) to VALIDATED required before bounded C-DELTA-REPAIR (delta < full-task, contamination<0.10) and honest C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY M_total_f10 Pareto can be attempted?
hypothesis: H1-positive: After prevalence rebalancing to 15% stale on the same synthetic single-resource deterministic site with honest constant integer sum-counter, recalibrated 0.95/0.85, prevalence-aware UNKNOWN [0.00,0.18] and per-class ECE<=0.15 remain satisfiable: the combined guard achieves synthetic-rebalanced TN>=0.85 (Wilson lower>0.75), FA<=0.10 (Wilson upper<0.18), UNKNOWN=stale_rate=0.1428 within [0.0928,0.2128] and [0.00,0.18], global ECE~0.07-0.10 and per-class each<=0.15, per-family TP>=0.85 for 3 families (dom_drift, param_header_mutation, cache_expiry) despite reduced stale n=30 (power via 180 fresh), discriminating vs B-NO-GUARD FA delta>=0.88 and vs B-JACCARD-ONLY FA~0.66 / B-HEADER-ONLY FA~0.33, with max|rho_shuffled|<0.20 trajectory-grouped, non-degenerate 5000 bootstrap CIs (width>0, not [1.0,1.0]/[0.0,0.0]), and NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY FA<=0.10 on 150 fresh churn/null noise; health-gated distributed transfer at n>=800 non-304 (single-node Flask/JWT first) will sustain TN>=0.85 FA<=0.10 calibrated per endpoint if runtime substrate is healthy, otherwise that stage is MEASUREMENT_INVALID without falsifying the synthetic gate. Signal necessity remains orthogonal (DOM+header/cache combined), not pooled-metric salience or cost tautology.
falsifier: C-FRESHNESS synthetic-rebalanced detection is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if ANY of (F1) TN_SPIDER <0.85 OR Wilson lower (95%, z=1.96) <=0.75 on the 180-fresh pool; (F2) false_accept_SPIDER = P(EXECUTABLE|stale) >0.10 on the 30-stale pool (Wilson upper reported, point>0.10 fails); (F3) UNKNOWN outside prevalence-aware bound [0.00,0.18] OR outside [stale_rate-0.05, stale_rate+0.07] (stale_rate=30/210=0.1428 => allowed [0.0928,0.2128] intersect [0.00,0.18] => [0.0928,0.18]); (F4) global ECE >0.15 OR per-class ECE_fresh >0.15 OR per-class ECE_stale >0.15 under recalibrated 0.95/0.85; (F5) false_accept_NO_GUARD - false_accept_SPIDER <0.15 OR false_accept_NO_GUARD <=0.10 (no discriminating advantage); (F6) per-family TN<0.75 for stable fresh OR per-family TP<0.85 for any of 3 drift families (dom_drift, param_header_mutation, cache_expiry) at 10 stale per family; (F7) NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY FA>0.10 on 150 optional-field churn/null fresh; (F8) degenerate Wilson lower=1.0/upper=0.0 with width 0 on BOTH point and bootstrap viewed as non-informative is NOT itself a falsifier at rebalanced prevalence — but bootstrap CIs must be non-degenerate (width>0) to claim precision, otherwise validity_notes ceiling effect. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any honesty gate fails: (M1) sum-counter not honest constant integer (jitter, n*3200/f*6.0, parity, global template); (M2) M-RHO-SHUFFLED max|rho|>=0.20 trajectory-grouped 1000 perms; (M3) within-family freshness std ==0 for any drift family; (M4) verification not deterministic src/spider/kernel.py _matches; (M5) 5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap not performed; (M6) per-trajectory observed caching not used or endpoint not response-derived; (M7) N<180 fresh+30 stale on synthetic-rebalanced or server failure; (M-DIST) distributed n_non304<800 or health-gate X-Worker-Pid<2 or HS256 mismatch => that stage MEASUREMENT_INVALID, does not retroactively falsify synthetic gate.

baselines.description: No freshness guard: same 180+30+150=360-request rebalanced workload, same mechanisms, resolve() always EXECUTABLE when preconditions+required_slots pass, never UNKNOWN. Postconditions verified post-hoc via deterministic _matches only for measurement. Expected: false_accept ~1.0 on 30 stale (all accepted), UNKNOWN=0 fails D3, TN~1.0 on 180 fresh trivial, FA delta vs SPIDER >=0.88 if SPIDER FA<=0.10. Matched task, strong baseline via prevalence-aware UNKNOWN.

Ablation: freshness uses only DOM field-set Jaccard <0.85 (required-filtered {id,name,email}), ignoring response-derived Cache-Control/ETag and endpoint _template/X-Csrf-Token mutation. Threshold 0.85 frozen. Tests signal isolation necessity at 15% prevalence with n_stale=30 (10 per family).
baselines.expected: FA ~0.66, TP 10/30 only dom_drift (10/10), param_header 0/10 cache 0/10, fails F6

baselines.description: Ablation: freshness uses only Cache-Control+ETag (ETag_changed AND max-age=0) plus response-derived header/endpoint _template mutation, ignoring DOM Jaccard drift. Same frozen thresholds. Complementary to B-JACCARD-ONLY, isolates header/cache channel at realistic sparsity.
baselines.expected: FA ~0.33, TP 20/30 (param_header 10/10 + cache 10/10, dom_drift 0/10), fails F6

positive_control: PC-STALE-DETECTION: Deterministic injected stale responses at request >=DRIFT_POINT=6 per trajectory must be flagged stale/UNKNOWN with TP>=0.85 per family (10 stale per family => 9/10, Wilson lower >0.60 with n=10) on the rebalanced synthetic single-resource /resource/{id} flat-JSON site: (1) dom_drift: server changes JSON body field-set (add optional phone, change id int->str) Jaccard 0.60-0.75 <0.85 detectable via required-filtered tokens; (2) param_header_mutation: server response-derived mutation query param detail->uid signaled via _template field and X-Csrf-Token abc123->xyz789 detectable via endpoint_template equality on response-derived names; (3) cache_expiry: server ETag=SHA256(filtered_body)[:16] changes + Cache-Control max-age 60->0 detectable via ETag_changed AND max-age=0 with deterministic If-None-Match 304 marked not stale. Per-trajectory observed caching (first valid of requests 1-5) vs live response. PC passes only if per-family TP>=0.85; for n=10 disclosure uses exact Wilson. Distributed PC-DISTR: same three families on Flask/JWT substrate at n>=800 non-304 stratified 267 per family minimum, TP>=0.85 Wilson lower>0.75 required if health-gate passes.
null_control: NC-FRESH-RETAIN: Fresh responses (request <DRIFT_POINT, no mutation, ETag stable, max-age=60) on 180 fresh pool must be retained EXECUTABLE with TN>=0.85 Wilson lower>0.75, not flagged stale, 304 deterministically not counted stale. NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY: Frozen stimulus of 150 fresh noise requests (15 trajectories x10, 5 per churn variant: A phone added p=0.3, B nickname added p=0.3, C email=null p=0.2 + phone p=0.3) all fresh ground truth, must NOT trigger staleness: require FA_NOISE = # flagged stale/150 <=0.10 and TN_NOISE>=0.85. Guard uses required-path filter {id,name,email} excluding optional phone/nickname; ETag change alone without max-age=0 not flagged. Both NCs use deterministic _matches ground truth, per-trajectory caching, response-derived signals. Distributed NC-DISTR: same fresh retain and noise immunity on Flask/JWT at n>=800 if health-gated, otherwise noted as not attempted.
measurement_validity: V1_DETERMINISTIC_VERIFICATION: postcondition verification via src/spider/kernel.py _matches(required, actual) exact equality on required_slots = set(parameter_slots) | _template_slots(action_template) filtered without _template; no heuristic/LLM; hashes logged per request.

V2_HONEST_SUM_COUNTER_CONSTANT: per-trajectory-reset honest integer sum-counter = resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser_steps (browser_steps=0 deterministic), integer ops per request base 4, no traj_idx%2 parity, no f*6.0/n*3200/n*4096, no Gaussian jitter, no bijective proxy; per-request and per-trajectory sum logged, all_int true, mean ~4, vector std 0 exempt from V5.

V3_NO_JITTER_NO_PROXY: verification that cost vector contains no injected variance: all costs integers, equal (or only legitimate op-count variance), integer property holds, std==0 valid for constant cost.

V4_RHO_SHUFFLED_MAX_TRAJECTORY_GROUPED: max |Pearson rho| between shuffled cost labels and outcome over 1000 permutations shuffling WHOLE TRAJECTORY BLOCKS preserving within-trajectory dependence, max (primary) <0.20 and mean auxiliary reported; covers prior tautology and mean-vs-max misreporting.

V5_WITHIN_FAMILY_STD_OUTCOME: within-each-drift-family std of freshness score (Jaccard/binary stale flag) and accuracy/outcome must be >0 for discrimination; binary flag std 0.5 expected; cost std gate EXCLUDED (V2); stable-only exempt no stale variation.

V6_TRAJECTORY_GROUPED_BOOTSTRAP_5000: 5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap resampling at trajectory/family level (12 fresh trajs 15 each=180, 6 stale trajs 3 families 2 each? actually 6 trajectories per family? rebalanced: 2 trajectories per drift family x10=60 but with 30 stale pool => 1 fresh trajectory per family + shared fresh pool? Stratified preserving 180 fresh +10 per family stale +150 noise proportions), recompute TN, FA, UNKNOWN, global ECE, per-class ECE per iteration for 95% percentile CIs; preserves dependence, avoids hiding per-family 0/10 via pooled.

V7_WILSON_CI: Wilson score interval z=1.96 for TN and false_accept on raw counts not smoothed; lower bound for TN, upper for FA reported; non-degeneracy check: at rebalanced n=180/30 CIs must have width>0 (lower<1.0, upper>0.0); degenerate [1.0,1.0] flagged as ceiling but not falsifier if point passes.

V8_ECE_CALIBRATION_RECALIBRATED_PREVALENCE_AWARE: ECE over 10 equal-width bins [0,0.1)...[0.9,1.0] on SPIDER recalibrated confidence 0.95 fresh/EXECUTABLE and 0.85 stale/UNKNOWN; global ECE = sum_b |acc_b-conf_b|*n_b/N <=0.15; per-class ECE_fresh and ECE_stale each <=0.15 on class-conditional subsets; UNKNOWN gate prevalence-aware: UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.18] (0.30/210 cap) AND within [stale_rate-0.05, stale_rate+0.07] (stale_rate 30/210=0.1428 => [0.0928,0.2128]); satisfiable proof 180*0.05/210=0.0429 +30*0.15/210=0.0214=0.0643 global <0.15.

V9_SINGLE_RESOURCE_ISOLATION_SYNTHETIC: synthetic site ONE resource type /resource/{id} only, orthogonal drift families separate trajectories no cross-scheduling, header/body signals separated; rebalanced sampling keeps family proportions (10 stale per family) and 180 fresh no-drift.

V10_DETERMINISTIC_FRESHNESS_SIGNAL_RESPONSE_DERIVED: DOM tokens sorted {(field_path,type)} via extract_field_types on JSON body; ETag SHA256(canonical_json)[:16]; Cache-Control max-age; endpoint_template from response-signaled _template field + X-Csrf-Token header name/value from response (not client dict); all deterministic response-derived.

V11_FAMILY_STRATIFIED_SAMPLING_REBALANCED: 180 fresh (12 trajectories x15 requests, no drift) + 30 stale (3 families x2 trajectories x10 with 5 fresh+5 stale, DRIFT_POINT=6 => 15 fresh already counted? Adjust to 10 stale per family =30 stale total) + 150 noise (15 trajectories x10, 5 per variant) =360 total; stale_rate 30/210=0.1428 on staleness pool; preserves Wilson sensitivity at n_stale=30 (0/30 upper 0.1135).

V12_LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_SITE_VS_DISTRIBUTED: synthetic stdlib http.server on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port no external deps for primary gate; distributed health-gated Flask/JWT+nginx as secondary stage in same experiment if runtime substrate available via research/harness; secondary stage health-gated not required for synthetic SURVIVES.

V13_GROUND_TRUTH_LOGGING: every request logs ground_truth (fresh/stale/noise), family, trajectory_id, request_number, url, response body, ETag, Cache-Control, threshold decision, confidence 0.95/0.85, _matches outcome to raw_evidence/*.json with SHA256, per-trajectory cache contents logged to per_trajectory_cache.json.

V14_PER_TRAJECTORY_OBSERVED_CACHING_RESPONSE_DERIVED_ENDPOINT: cache postconditions = dom_tokens/header_tokens/endpoint_template observed from pre-drift requests 1-5 per trajectory (first valid deterministic) not global precomputed; endpoint mutation detection compares live response-derived signal to cached response-derived signal; closes prior gaps; If-None-Match 304 deterministically returns 304 only when fresh etag matches, marked not stale.
V15_ORTHOGONAL_LEVELS_AUDIT: audit checks combined signal necessity (B-JACCARD-ONLY and B-HEADER-ONLY must fail) and trajectory-grouped max rho + honest counter independently logged.

V-DIST-HEALTH-GATE: distributed substrate health check before counting: shared WAL file exists with WAL/journal_mode, 2x gunicorn workers responding with distinct X-Worker-Pid (at least 2 distinct pids across 10 probe requests), HS256 JWT verified with shared TESTBED_SECRET on protected endpoint, nginx If-None-Match returns 304 on second conditional GET with same ETag, n_non304 distinct counting excludes 304; if any check fails => distributed stage logged as MEASUREMENT_INVALID with reason, synthetic gate still adjudicated.

V-DIST-N-SUFFICIENCY: distributed stage requires n>=800 non-304 stratified >=250 per family for Wilson lower>0.75 sensitivity; if n<800 after health gate => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for distributed stage with n_actual reported.
decision_rule: PRIMARY SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (synthetic-rebalanced) if ALL of: (D1) TN_SPIDER>=0.85 AND Wilson lower>0.75 on 180 fresh; (D2) false_accept<=0.10 on 30 stale (Wilson upper reported); (D3) UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.18] AND within [stale_rate-0.05, stale_rate+0.07] (stale_rate 0.1428 => [0.0928,0.2128]); (D4) global ECE<=0.15 AND per-class ECE_fresh<=0.15 AND ECE_stale<=0.15 under 0.95/0.85 recalibrated; (D5) B-NO-GUARD FA - SPIDER FA >=0.15 AND B-NO-GUARD FA>0.10; (D6) per-family TP>=0.85 for each 3 families (9/10) and per-family TN>=0.75 on fresh pool; (D7) PC per-family TP>=0.85; (D8) NC-FRESH-RETAIN TN>=0.85 and NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY FA<=0.10; (D9) honesty gates V2-V6 pass (constant integer counter, max|rho|<0.20 trajectory-grouped, freshness std>0, 5000 bootstrap done, per-trajectory caching+response-derived verified) AND Wilson/bootstrap CIs non-degenerate width>0. FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if any D1-D8 fails while D9 passes (valid scientific negative on calibration/detection at realistic prevalence). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any V2-V6 honesty gate fails, verification not _matches, 304 mishandled, per-trajectory caching not used, endpoint not response-derived, or N<180+30. DISTRIBUTED STAGE: CONDITIONAL_SURVIVES if health-gated n>=800 non-304 and same D1-D8 thresholds hold per endpoint and overall with Wilson lower>0.75; if health-gate fails or n<800 => DISTRIBUTED_MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that stage (validity_notes, does not override synthetic PRIMARY falsification/survival). Overall packet SURVIVES requires PRIMARY SURVIVES; DISTRIBUTED SURVIVES upgrades claim ceiling toward VALIDATED but not required for PRIMARY SURVIVES. INCONCLUSIVE only if primary CIs straddle thresholds with width>0.20 due to underpower at n_stale=30 — disclosed but not expected.
product_consequence_positive: Synthetic-rebalanced SURVIVES: freshness guard sustains TN>=0.85 FA<=0.10 calibrated (global/per-class ECE<=0.15, UNKNOWN [0.00,0.18] prevalence-aware, non-degenerate Wilson 0.979 lower / 0.1135 upper and 5000 trajectory-grouped bootstrap width>0, noise-immunity FA<=0.10) at realistic 15% stale prevalence with honest constant sum-counter and trajectory-grouped max rho<0.20, discriminating vs B-NO-GUARD delta>=0.88 and vs single-signal ablations. This upgrades C-FRESHNESS from degenerate synthetic EXPERIMENTAL (42.8% ceiling) to non-degenerate honest prevalence-aware EXPERIMENTAL and prereqs: removes per_hit tautology blocker for C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY M_total_f10 Pareto and unblocks bounded C-DELTA-REPAIR (localized repair delta < full-task, contamination<0.10) on same synthetic substrate without distributed WAL. If distributed health-gated stage also CONDITIONAL_SURVIVES at n>=800 non-304, advances toward VALIDATED (requires audit PASS) and authorizes prep for product promotion planning, still keeps WebArena add_to_cart pilots PARKED until kernel durability gates independently pass.
product_consequence_negative: Synthetic-rebalanced FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING: even at satisfiable recalibrated operating point (0.95/0.85, prevalence-aware UNKNOWN) guard fails any of TN<0.85, FA>0.10, UNKNOWN outside [0.0928,0.18], ECE>0.15 global/per-class, no FA delta vs no-guard, per-family TP<0.85, or noise-immunity FA>0.10 at 15% prevalence while honesty gates pass. Demonstrates prior TN 1.0 FA 0.0 was inflated by 42.8% stale prevalence and degenerate 120+90 CIs; realistic sparsity breaks calibration/detection with current Jaccard+header/cache signals. Product must NOT use this gate for reuse at 0.85 threshold and 0.95/0.85 scheme; reuse remains unsafe without selective-UNKNOWN policy, orthogonal signals (workflow IR, endpoint catalog, WebMCP tool discovery, hierarchical retrieval per director prior 6), or threshold retuning. Blocks C-FRESHNESS VALIDATED and keeps C-DELTA-REPAIR/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY+PARKED on synthetic; requires orthogonal level of description before re-attempt, and distributed transfer remains BLOCKED. Bounded to this signal/threshold/site/prevalence, does NOT close broader C-FRESHNESS domain (session/token drift, production CDN/304, SQLite WAL).
estimated_cost: Primary synthetic-rebalanced: same stdlib http.server single-resource as parent, ~300 lines server +400 lines harness, N=360 requests (210 staleness +150 noise), 5000 trajectory-grouped bootstraps CPU-only <12 min, <0.6 compute-hour, <$1, no LLM/browser/Docker. Secondary health-gated distributed: IF runtime substrate healthy, Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT 2.13.0 HS256 + gunicorn 23 + nginx 1.24 shared WAL /tmp/spider-runtime/*/shared.db, n>=800 non-304 at ~5 req/s ~3 min + bootstraps ~3 min, total <1 compute-hour, <$2; if health-gate fails, secondary cost zero and logged as DISTRIBUTED_MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Total bounded <1.5 compute-hour even with both stages.
expected_information_gain: Very high per Director CONTINUE rationale: this is the single highest-leverage blocked prerequisite (C-FRESHNESS 1/15 recent, blocks C-DELTA-REPAIR 4x BLOCKED, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-PRODUCT-ECON per_hit tautology). Rebalancing to honest 15% prevalence directly tests whether prior 71-90% manipulation inflated TN/UNKNOWN/ECE and whether degenerate [1.0,1.0]/[0.0,0.0] CIs masked false_accept, with non-degenerate Wilson (180 fresh lower 0.979, 30 stale upper 0.1135) and 5000 trajectory-grouped bootstrap width>0 as validity gate. Either SURVIVES (validates recalibrated prevalence-aware bound and upgrades EXPERIMENTAL toward VALIDATED, unblocks synthetic delta-repair and honest Pareto) or FALSIFIES (calibrated negative: freshness at 0.85 requires orthogonal workflow-IR/endpoint-catalog levels per prior 6, not threshold tweak) changes next graph/product/runtime decision. Health-gated distributed transfer at n>=800 then tests synthetic-to-distributed gap that is explicit VALIDATED blocker per registry. Cannot be obtained by repeating WebArena add_to_cart param-inherit pilots (expected repeat MEASUREMENT_INVALID on durability gates, marginal info ~0).
